_source: Cavendish Coworking's doors. Ryan's brief, 2026-09-25: our Editorial and Operations meetings are open to the world as part of our commitment to transparency, they have been held in our Discord, and many people refuse to use Discord, so a shopfront on the street with a door onto each of our calls. Until 2026-09-28 each door opened a Proton Meet room; since then each opens a room of its own, with its call in it (see _rooms). The Events room was added the same afternoon. EVERY TAGLINE, DESCRIPTION AND TIME IS WORD FOR WORD OFF OUR OWN EVENTS PAGE, https://stimpunks.org/events/, read in the Knowledge System mirror and against the live page on 2026-09-25; tools/make-coworking.py re-reads the mirror and refuses a line that is no longer on it. The door links are Ryan's, pasted in the brief. The doors are in the events page's own order, events before meetings, which is not ours to re-sort.

doors.name: Events
doors.tagline: The steady pulse beneath everything we do.
doors.said: Our recurring events are the heartbeat of Stimpunks: weekly, consistent, and always here.

slots.tagline: The radical act of showing up for each other.
Bring Your Muchness Down the Rabbit Hole
Expert lecturers. Community wisdom. Zero hierarchy.
Drop in. Space out. Belong here.
slots.said: Weekdays, 9AM Central — and spontaneously whenever someone feels like gathering

rack._why: Ryan's brief, 2026-10-08: a shared screen in the Events Room, with these on a rack, in the order he gave them, the first on the screen when you arrive. Each was checked on its own watch page on the day: public, playable in an embed, not age-restricted, not live, and its runtime. Their titles are their channels'; the notes are ours and say only what the titles and descriptions say is in them. The screen is the page's first, so a moderator's Screen a video goes up on it too.
rack.off: The ten scenes from CBC are off it until you put them back.

videos.title: Schitt's Creek Top 10 Funniest Scenes
videos.note: Ten scenes from the show, chosen by CBC and put up for its tenth anniversary.

videos.title: Alexis & David's Friendship Timeline - Schitt's Creek
videos.note: Alexis and David, from estranged siblings to friends, cut together in the order it happened.

videos.title: Schitt's Creek Funniest Scenes According to Fans
videos.note: Scenes chosen by fans this time, after CBC asked under its own ten which ones it had missed.

videos.title: The Rise of Rose Apothecary (Timeline) - Schitt’s Creek
videos.note: David turns the town’s general store into Rose Apothecary, with help from Patrick and Alexis, cut together in the order it happened.

doors.name: Operations
doors.said: The Operations meeting is where the work of keeping Stimpunks running gets done. Each week we hold a task scrub — triage, prioritize, and move work forward together. If you want to understand how the organization operates or get involved in the doing, this is the meeting for you.

doors.name: Editorial
doors.tagline: Words, design, and everything we put into the world.
doors.said: The Editorial meeting is where we work on the Stimpunks website and print materials — writing, editing, and designing for publication. Whether you’re a writer, editor, designer, or someone who just cares deeply about how we communicate, join us.

_suites: The Hang Suites are Ryan's, written in his brief of 2026-09-25 and copied here as he gave them, with three changes: both lurking norms said 'camera and video off' and Ryan corrected them to 'camera and mic off' the same day; the Watering Hole's list of norms was headed 'Campfire Norms' in the brief, a slip, and is headed with its own room's name; and the opening line said how many rooms there are, which check-counts.py refuses, so it says 'rooms'. Until 2026-09-28 each suite opened a Proton Meet room; each opens a room of its own now. They are named for Cavendish Space's caves, campfires and watering holes, which are David Thornburg's, and make-coworking.py refuses the section if the room stops naming him. A suite has no times on purpose: they are drop-in rooms, and a suite with hours is a meeting and belongs with the doors.
suites_intro: Wanna just hang out or work on something together? We have rooms for that.

suites.name: Cave
suites.said: The Cave / Quiet Room is for quiet co-presence, ambient togetherness, and low-demand connection.
norms: It’s okay to text a hi to the room.

rack._why: Ryan's brief, 2026-09-28: the Cave gets a selection of cave videos, to be curated. Claude shortlisted, and Ryan chose every one on the shortlist but the two described as eerie or spooky, with the Mount Cucco cave on the screen when you arrive. Each was checked on its own watch page on the day: public, playable in an embed, not age-restricted, not live, and its runtime. Nobody here has watched them all the way through. Their titles are their channels'; the notes are ours and say only what the titles, descriptions and chapters say is in them.
rack.off: The Mount Cucco cave is off it until you put it back.

videos.title: Water Dripping Sound in Mystical Cave on Mount Cucco ~ Umbria ASMR

videos.note: The back of a sea cave in South Africa on a rough day, recorded with no loops or effects. The waves are loud.

videos.title: ASMR Sound 2021 - Xagħra Ta' Ninu's Cave - The Dropping Water From Stalactites to Stalagmites.
videos.note: Water dropping from stalactites in Ta' Ninu's cave on Gozo, after heavy rain, in the camera's own sound.

videos.title: Ocean wave sounds - Waves in a sea cave, Scotland

videos.title: 1 Hour 4K Ice Cave - Calm View inside a Frozen Glacier in Alaska with Natural Water Sounds
videos.note: A second hour inside a glacier in Alaska: still ice, and water running.

videos.title: [自然音と4K映像]  伊豆の龍宮窟と海と洞窟とリラックス/Japan Relaxing Nature Ocean Waves & Cave Sounds in Izu “Ryugukutsu"

videos.title: Thurston Lava Tube Walk ASMR | Volcanoes National Park Hawaii | 4K No Talking
videos.note: A walk through Thurston Lava Tube in Hawaii: footsteps, drips and the echo.

suites.name: Campfire
suites.said: The Campfire is for small groups and teams working on something together or watching/listening together.
norms: Mute when you’re not actively talking.
Quietly lurking with camera and mic off is perfectly fine and accepted.

rack._why: Ryan's brief, 2026-09-28: the Campfire gets the selection from the fire pit at Swaying Sweetgrass. The screen is that fire pit's own playlist, read out of data/sweetgrass.json by key; the cards are fires from it, and since 2026-09-29 they live with the fire pit too, read out of data/sweetgrass.json by key under hearth.fires, because the fire pit took the rack the same way and one list must not be kept in two files. Their titles are the channel's and sell them for sleep and focus; the notes are ours and say only what is in them.
rack.rack_title: The fires, from the fire pit at Swaying Sweetgrass
rack.off: The whole playlist is off it until you put it back.

suites.name: Watering Hole
suites.said: The Watering Hole is for open, come-and-go, group Watercooler chat where random and off-topic are on-topic. This is a casual, drop-in space where people come together without any particular agenda.
norms: Mute when you’re not actively talking.
Quietly lurking with camera and mic off is perfectly fine and accepted.
Come-and-go as you please. If you need to drop out suddenly, no need to worry with goodbyes. We understand.

rack._why: Ryan's brief, 2026-09-28: the Watering Hole gets a selection from the Jungle Room, particularly the Namib Desert, the otters and the jellyfish. The cams are read out of data/jungle.json by id, never restated, so the two rooms cannot say two different things about one camera, and a cam that goes dark there goes dark here.
rack.rack_title: The cams: the desert, the otters and the jellies
rack.off: The desert is off it until you put it back.

access_note.title: A Note on Communication Access
access_note.said: We support multiple modes of participation including text chat, audio, and video — whatever works for your communication needs on a given day. You do not need to speak to belong here.

_rooms: Ryan's brief, 2026-09-28: Proton goes, and every door opens onto a room of its own with a call in it, through 8x8's Jitsi as a Service. A door with a `page` opens that room; `room` is the room's own name, `prefix` the class prefix its section of love.css dresses the generated parts in. Events, Operations and Editorial are public calls (PUBLIC_CALLS in netlify/cb/lib.mjs, which make-coworking.py reads); the suites are for people signed on to the CB. Every door has its room now, and make-coworking.py refuses one that does not.
